How to freeze your card

If your card is lost or you notice suspicious activity, you can freeze it immediately from the mobile app. Open the app, go to Cards, select your card, and tap Freeze card. While frozen, new payments are blocked but you can unfreeze at any time.

If your card was stolen, freeze it first and then report the card as lost or stolen so we can send a replacement.
